QuestInfo.name: [Silent Crusade] A Crack in Time
QuestInfo.0: Let's ask Starling, who's returned from the investigation, what she found out.
QuestInfo.1: A Crack in Time has appeared at the Temple of Time! Did Arkarium cause the crack? How could he have infiltrated the area without anyone noticing? What is he trying to accomplish?!
QuestInfo.2: Go to the Temple of Time with Bastille and investigate the crack.\nSince it might end up being super dangerous, you must be at least #r#eLv. 140#n#k to carry out the next mission. You'd get destroyed otherwise.

0.msg: There's something strange going on at the Temple of Time. Time is rippling outward, almost like someone has created a crack in the timestream! Between this new threat and the outpouring of Mystic Gates, we HAVE to be dealing with something bigger!
#p9073011# is right next to me. Please go talk to him.

The puzzle is falling together, and I think Arkarium is the final piece. If he's messing with time, we're all in a lot of trouble. He could change the entire timeline! He could make us forget that we ever knew each other, and we'd never even know it! We have to get into that temple and stop his evil schemes!
